affine_inlining_justification: Equation (10.1) permits arbitrary K-linear forms in each factor. Eliminating addition gates by substitution in those forms preserves equations and introduces no new commitment. Quadratic products still have canonical gate wires.

basis_maps.reason: Identity maps, implemented as views/copies, not arithmetic matrices.

matrix_application_model: Each stored coefficient times an Fq witness coordinate is one K-by-Fq scalar product; row additions are stored_entries minus nonempty_rows. A transpose with K-valued equality weights uses one K multiplication per slot and stored_entries minus nonempty_columns additions. Explicit public zero slots are processed.

public_coefficients.description: 16 c-pole subtractions; prefix 16 multiplies; backward batch inverse 32; 16 squares; 16 carrier Dinv*c^t multiplies and 15 powers; 5 public coordinates each 16 multiply/add. Inversion is a primitive K_inv.
public_coefficients.dictionary_policy: One K multiplication per weighted recipe in the literal implementation; signs/powers-of-two are public constants. Copy literal recipes; negate each public recipe with four Fq negations.

witness_construction.scope: Construct output and auxiliary witness from supplied source records and supplied honest carrier. Excludes synthetic fixture generation and literal pair carrier used only by regression.
